Available commands:
  /clear — clear session
  /cost — view costs

  /model — view model
  /compact — compact context
  /spec — write/update a spec
  /plan — write/update an execution plan
  /coding — implement the approved plan
  /review — review code changes
  /memory — manage memory file
  /init — initialize agent instructions
